name: com.nexus.ads.admob
description: Google AdMob (Google Mobile Ads Unity plugin, with User Messaging Platform consent): AdMobProvider, the com.nexus.ads family's IAdProvider (assembly Nexus.Ads.AdMob, compiles only with com.nexus.ads and the plugin 11.3.0+), with UmpConsentFlow, Google's consent form, which the ads bootstrap also runs before LevelPlay; with com.nexus.firebase also installed, UmpAnalyticsConsent, the analytics consent its services read (assembly Nexus.Ads.AdMob.Firebase).
